newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Top shares mixed, Prague PX50 up one pt to 580.2.
newsitem.headline: Top shares mixed, Prague PX50 up one pt to 580.2.

text.p: A mixed bag for leading shares on the Prague Stock Exchange ended with the official PX50 index gaining one point on Tuesday, as light losses in banking shares were countered by minor gains in utilities.

A five crown gain in power giant CEZ to 1,050 and a six crown gain in telephone monopoly SPT Telecom a.s. helped nudge the PX50 to 580.2, its sixth-straight 1996 high water mark in a thin but advancing market.

The Reuters RPIX index, measuring the seven stocks trading on a continuously-quoted market instead the bourse's once-daily fixing, rose one point from Monday's close to 1,174, turnover was typical for the niche market at eight million crowns.
On the broader market, advancing issues led decliners 181 to 144, on moderate volume of 707,680 shares and turnover of 557 million crowns.
Among highly watched issues, savings bank Ceska Sporitelna gained six crowns to 354, and the largest commercial bank Komercni Banka was unchanged at 2,460.
